subject.title: fix: cloud-worker results are lost when the box dies before reconciliation

question: Should this nullable additive `staged_result_ref` column advance the persistent state schema from v4 to v5, or should the PR retain v4 and rely on the existing additive-column ensure path?
rationale: The repository policy reserves schema-version bumps for incompatible changes and requires explicit acceptance; the supplied PR discussion does not establish that acceptance.

options.title: Keep the state version at v4
options.body: Retain the additive `ensureColumn` migration and remove the v5 version changes because older readers tolerate the nullable column.

options.title: Explicitly approve v5
options.body: Accept a schema-version transition only after documenting why this additive column cannot safely remain under the v4 compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Keep the state version at v4
recommendation.body: Retain the additive `ensureColumn` migration and remove the v5 version changes because older readers tolerate the nullable column.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned author owns the proposed persistence and recovery design and can provide or obtain the required schema-version decision.
